description: Categories of audit ledger records. The API refuses to write a record whose category is not listed here and filters the ledger by them; the console offers them as filters. in_desktop_contract: the category exists in the desktop's VendorAdminAuditActionCategoryV1 (shared/ipc-types.ts); the others are written by the control API only (vendor sign-in, customers, operators, billing, rollout governance). Append-only: never rename or remove an entry, records keep their category forever.
